name: TSP Wind Power Group Co., Ltd.
summary: TSP Wind Power Group Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells wind towers in China. It offers onshore wind power equipment under its own brand, including steel and reinforced concrete towers, as well as offshore wind power and marine engineering equipment comprising offshore towers, jacket structures, pipe piles, substation platforms, and related accessories and parts. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Taisheng Wind Power Equipment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TSP Wind Power Group Co., Ltd. in March 2025. Shanghai Taisheng Wind Power Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
